candidate_merges.message: Raise Aspire's minimum supported .NET version to .NET 10 (#20614) ## Description Raise the supported .NET baseline on `main` for the next major Aspire release. Shipping libraries and C# templates no longer need to support .NET 8 or .NET 9, and repository builds/tests should not require those SDKs or runtimes. - Set `DefaultTargetFramework` to `net10.0` and `AllTargetFrameworks` to `net10.0;net11.0`, with framework-aligned 10.x/11.x dependencies. Keep the CLI on its existing `net11.0` target. - R
